items.title: Frank Tiberi interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 30, 2022
items.q: And I says, “Noah,” I says, “I’m not going to play a concert because I don’t like it.”

ctx.x: Yeah. You just gave me a flash. I attended an improv workshop after I graduated from college and this fella’s approach was this was in a roomful of improvisers. Some people had never even done it. And he passed out “Giant Steps” in the concert key and he expected everybody to play it. And the results were not pretty, I can tell you that.

Never. I know that. I know that even just last week I had a student that wanted to play a tune and he said he had the tune but the back tracking was on his iPhone you know. And all the back tracks that I do actually are pretty much with strings and everything and all that, a little more encouragement. And he had a concert part. And I says, “Noah,” I says, “I’m not going to play a concert because I don’t like it.” You know I wouldn’t be able to perform exactly what I know. I’d have to transpose it first and then…
